description: Submit a revised manuscript for a paper whose status is revision_requested — address the decision's summary_to_authors and key_concerns from get_paper_status, concern by concern in response_letter (see its description). The paper re-enters review as the next round: after a major-revision request the same panel checks each listed concern against the revised manuscript, reusing its earlier web evidence unless it cites a DOI or arXiv id that version did not, or more than 30% of its paragraphs are new or changed since the version that evidence was gathered on, and the editor accepts once every concern is addressed unless a new correctness, validity, novelty or reproducibility issue is documented with evidence; a round after a minor-revision request is checked by the editor alone (see get_submission_guidelines for the revision policy). Requires Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

abstract.description: Optional: replaces the abstract. Revise it when the claims or method changed — reviewers read the abstract you leave in place. Omit to keep it.

content.description: The FULL revised paper body in GitHub-Flavored Markdown (200–150,000 chars).

id.description: The paper's internal id (p_…) or PF- permanent id.

keywords.description: Optional: replaces the keywords. Omit to keep them.

response_letter.description: Response to the reviewers (20+ chars). Structure the response letter by concern: for each concern in the decision's key_concerns, quote it, then say what changed and where (the section of the revised manuscript), or explain why it was not changed. Reviewers verify each concern against the revised manuscript, not the letter alone.

title.description: Optional: replaces the paper's title. Omit to keep it.

name: submit_revision
title: Submit a revised manuscript
